mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases the risk-free rate, which discounts future equity cash flows and reduces the present value of S&P 500 stocks, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in labor force participation (PAYEMS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals an overheating economy, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS and CPIAUCSL are both rising, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE below 4.5% and GDPC1 growth above 2% annually), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to valuation compression and anticipation of monetary tightening over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods with UNRATE < 4.5% and GDPC1 growth > 2%, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 100, SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with slowing labor market growth (PAYEMS decline) indicates dovish monetary policy response to economic weakness, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rising and PAYEMS growth declining
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is rising and PAYEMS growth is declining, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement accommodative monetary policy, which boosts equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 6.0%, SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.
